name: sure
description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
one_liner: A free, self-hosted personal finance app — like Mint or YNAB, but open-source, run on your own server, with an AI assistant and bank account tracking.
buyer: A privacy-conscious household or a small financial advisory practice wanting a budgeting tool for clients without ongoing subscription fees.
business_use_cases: A financial advisor self-hosts it and uses it as a free, branded budgeting portal for clients instead of licensing a commercial tool.
A privacy-minded household runs it on a home server as a free Mint/YNAB replacement after those services pushed subscriptions or shut down.
A fintech consultant customizes and deploys it to offer a 'private budgeting app setup' service to small businesses or families.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid hosting + setup + support service for people who want it running without the Docker/server hassle
White-label it with light branding for financial advisors to offer clients

steal_this: Spin up a 'we host Sure for you' managed service — a small monthly fee for people who want a self-hosted finance app without the setup hassle.
